title: A UCIe Optical I/O Retimer Chiplet for AI Scale-up
problem: High-bandwidth AI accelerator interconnects require low-latency optical I/O solutions to scale multi-chip systems while maintaining signal integrity across chiplet boundaries.
motivation: AI scale-up systems need chiplet-to-chiplet interconnects with optical signaling to overcome electrical I/O bottlenecks and enable efficient many-accelerator configurations.
method: This work designs a specialized chiplet that follows the UCIe interconnect standard. It uses optical transducers—devices that convert electrical signals to light and back again—to bridge electrical signals (used inside AI chips) and optical signals (light pulses between chips). The chiplet also includes signal conditioning circuits that clean up and re-time the signals to fix degradation that happens during transmission, maintaining reliability across the chip boundary.
key_novelty: A chiplet that follows the UCIe standard to convert electrical signals to optical signals and clean them up, enabling AI accelerator chips to connect and scale together.
contributions: Bridge between electrical and optical domains
Support for multi-chip AI system scaling
primary_theme: optical chiplet interconnect for AI scale-up
